question: Which of the following mountain ranges is home to the second-highest peak of the world, K2?
solution:
The correct answer is **__East Karakoram Range.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• K2 is also known as Mount Godwin Austen and locally it is known as Dapsang or Chogori is the world's second-highest peak.
 
• K2 is located in the Karakoram Range.
